faq: Is this an ADA compliance review?
No. This is practical guest-experience support: quiet space, signage, communication and staff guidance. It is not legal advice or ADA certification.
Do we need a meeting?
No. Everything can be done in writing. A short call is available for Event Setup and On-Site packages if you prefer one.
What if our event is in early December?
Book now. The Quick Kit arrives in 3 business days, and Event Setup in 5.
Can we pay by invoice or purchase order?
Yes. Choose your package, submit the form and note “invoice” or your PO details. You’ll get an invoice within 1 business day.
offers.boundary: Practical guest-experience improvements, not ADA certification or legal advice.

faq: What exactly is inside?
Every stocking includes the six item types listed above. Brands vary with supply, so we describe items by type rather than promise a specific brand.
Can we order more than 50?
Yes. Choose 50, then note your total in the form and you’ll get a volume quote.
Can we pay by invoice or PO?
Yes. Note your PO in the form. A 50% deposit reserves your packing slot.
Are these safe for kids?
The Desk Reset stocking is designed for adults. A kids version is on the way once every item is age-labeled and safety-certified.
offers.boundary: Desk Reset stockings are designed for adults and are not toys for young children.

offers.lede: Answer a few written questions about the person you’re shopping for. You get a curated gift plan you can buy from in one sitting, or I buy, wrap and ship it for you.

faq: What if I don’t know their sensory preferences?
Share what you do know. I’ll lean toward gentle, adjustable picks and note anything worth checking.
Are the links affiliate links?
Some may be. Picks are chosen for the person first, never for the commission.
Can I do more than one person?
Yes. Add up to 4 recipients at $29 each and describe each person in the notes.
What if the plan misses?
Reply to your plan email and I’ll revise it once at no charge.
